findings.quote: «Ingrid was three times later than Amoura» / «η Ιωάννα άργησε τρεις φορές περισσότερο από την Αμαλία»
findings.explanation: The source and adapted problem share an ambiguity: “three times later/more” can be read differently from “three times as late.” The solution adopts the evidently intended classroom convention that Ioanna’s delay is triple Amalia’s, yielding 3 × 55 = 165 minutes. This is inherited source ambiguity, not an editor-introduced mathematical error.
findings.suggested_action: The record may be kept under the ordinary classroom interpretation; if strict semantic uniqueness is required, clarify the problem wording as «η καθυστέρηση της Ιωάννας ήταν τριπλάσια» and resolve again.
